tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) for releases: a major version increment signals backward-incompatible changes, a minor version increment signals backward-compatible new functionality, and a patch version increment signals backward-compatible bug fixes. The recorded rationale is that this gives users a clearer signal about API compatibility and about when an update is safe to adopt versus when it requires changes to their code.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
